headline: 2 Michigan deals, $2.6M raised — led by Sprint Growth Fund, LP

top_deals.summary: Sprint Growth Fund, LP, an Okemos-based venture capital fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $1.6M sold to 10 investors.
MI Roof & Solar, LLC, a Ferndale-based company, filed a $1.1M pooled fund interests offering under Rule 506(b); $1.1M sold to 11 investors.

new_funds.summary: Sprint Growth Fund, LP, an Okemos-based venture capital fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $1.6M sold to 10 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $2.6M sold across 2 Form D filings this week, down 99% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was MI Roof & Solar, LLC (Ferndale, Other) targeting $1.1M. Good question to ask: are founders in other favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $1.6M raised so far — led by Sprint Growth Fund, LP (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Private Funds was the most active sector with 1 of 2 filings (50%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
